segments.text:
V. 49.
That Year—That memorable Year, in which Chriſt was to die. It was the laſt and chief of Daniel's Seventy Weeks, the fortieth Year before the Deſtruction of Jeruſalem, and was celebrated for various Cauſes, in the Jewiſh Hiſtory. Therefore that Year is ſo peculiarly mentioned: Caiaphas was the High-prieſt both before and after it. Ye know nothing—He reproves their ſlow Deliberations, in ſo clear a Caſe.
